exposure: Incidental exposure to novel oral poliovirus vaccine type 2 (nOPV2) via household/community shedding (exposed cohort)
cohort: The cohort consisted of 1266 pregnant women, with 326 enrolled from Nampula (nOPV2 exposed) and 940 from Maputo City (nOPV2 non-exposed) in Mozambique.
finding: The study found no increased frequency of most adverse pregnancy outcomes (stillbirth, low birth weight, congenital anomalies, neonatal death, maternal death) due to passive nOPV2 exposure, but did observe a higher rate of preterm delivery in the exposed group.
